title: Baby Ducky
body:
"Quack! Quack Quack! QUACKKKKK!!!! QUAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAACCCCCCCCCCCCCKKKKKKKKKKKKKKK"

Description

The Baby Ducky is a special item bought in the Classic Store for $125. It is part of the random rotation in the store. This is a small rubber duck that quacks when it comes into contact with something.

When buying, there is a chance that the duck will become Evil. Evil duck does not change its description and name, it differs only in appearance.

A duck will become an Adult if you place it in the Duck Shrine. The green particles are replaced by yellow ones. Works with both ducks. An Adult Duck is 4 times the size of a Baby Duck.

Also, the chance of getting an Evil Duck is about 1 in 75 and 1 in 125.
